text: Visitors have noted issues with low lighting in exhibit areas and a lack of clear signage, which made navigation confusing and frustrating for some. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as excessive and unhelpful. The timed entry system caused some crowding and long lines, with visitors advising to book early morning slots and arrive later within the allowed window to avoid wait times. Food service received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. Overall, while most ratings remain positive, these areas may need attention to improve the visitor experience.
